title: Costco Wholesale, FY2022 vs FY2021

attempts.text: Costco Wholesale Corporation reported a year-over-year increase of 15.8% in revenue from $195.9 billion in FY2021 to $227.0 billion in FY2022. Operating cash flow increased by 17.5% from $8.96 billion to $7.39 billion, and net income increased by 16.7% from $5.01 billion to $5.84 billion. These positive changes in financial metrics indicate improved operational efficiency and financial performance.

attempts.text: In FY2022, Costco Wholesale Corporation experienced a significant revenue growth of +15.8%, marking a substantial increase from the $195.9 billion reported in FY2021 to $227.0 billion. This growth is attributed to an operating income increase of +16.2%, which translates to an operating income of $7.79 billion, up from $6.71 billion in FY2021. The company also reported a net income increase of +16.7%, with $5.84 billion in FY2022 compared to $5.01 billion in FY2021, indicating a robust financial performance. Additionally, the company saw an increase in operating cash flow of +1.24 billion, reflecting improved liquidity and operational efficiency. Despite these positive developments, the largest decreases in FY2022 were in capital expenditure, which increased by +8.4% to $3.89 billion, and SG&A, which rose by +6.7% to $19.78 billion. These figures suggest that while the company is expanding its operations, it may be facing increased costs and potential liquidity pressures.

final_text: Costco revenue was $227.0bn in FY2022, up 15.8% from $195.9bn in FY2021. Operating margin was 3.43% (up 0.01 pp), with SG&A at 8.71% of revenue. The largest movements were: Operating cash flow decreased by $1.57bn; Net income increased by $0.84bn; Operating income increased by $1.08bn.
